description: This file implements the QemuManager class responsible for configuring and starting QEMU virtual machine instances, including setting up hardware, devices, networking, and console configurations within the Android Open Source Project's virtualization environment.

classes.name: QemuManager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing QEMU VM instances, including configuration, support checks, and command generation.

methods.name: QemuManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the QemuManager with a specific architecture.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if the host supports QEMU CLI.

methods.name: ConfigureGraphics
methods.description: Configures graphics and Vulkan-related settings based on the VM instance specifics.

methods.name: ConfigureBootDevices
methods.description: Configures boot device parameters based on architecture and VM configuration.

methods.name: StartCommands
methods.description: Generates the command sequence to start a QEMU VM with all necessary devices, networking, and configurations.
